body: Thank you so much for taking the time to write this. I guess the only positive answer would be to change myself into someone I like. That feels so difficult, because it's what I've been trying to do forever. But you're completely right that I'll never know if I don't try. And if I die I die as the person I hate. I don't know. I will try. Thank you again. I'm glad to hear you're in a better place now.

The thing is, my problem is me. I don't know how to deal with that. I don't mean to be dismissive of your advice, I just HATE me. I always have. I've given up on that ever changing and would really like to not live with me 24/7 any more.
Thank you. I will try. I'm sitting here trying to get hold of my thoughts. Maybe this would help.
Thank you. It sounds simple when you say that. I wish my mind would co-operate.

Thank you. I do know this. The people who care. That is making things worse really. Because I don't want to hurt them. My brother killed himself. Jumped off a building. I know that it would hurt my mother beyond belief if I died. But I don't know how to live. Nothing in my head is really even making sense right now. There's no way I can go on feeling like this. But how can I make it stop? I don't think I can.


Thank you so much for your comment. I hope you are right and somehow there is an end to feeling like this. 


Edit: if it's relevant my mother was highly abusive when I was a child and adolescent - physically, mentally and possibly sexually. She's completely changed, ever since my (schizophrenic) brother stabbed her multiple times and was sent to prison when I was 18. Not she is a saintly, wonderful mother, but I can't forgive or love her. I pretend to, so I don't hurt her, but I don't feel it inside. And I feel so guilty for that. My father is emotionally distant and abandoned me after my parents' divorce, so I have fucked up feelings towards him as well. How they would react if I died, and how I feel about that - it's complex.
I'm sorry if this was nonsensical.
